init_DistributedH5Reader: initialize a DistributedH5Reader with a base directory containing HDF5 files and JSON index maps
read_data_point: read a data point by index from HDF5 files and return a dict of torch tensors
read_with_keys: read specific keys from an HDF5 data point by index using the read method
get_dataset_length: get the total number of data points in the distributed HDF5 dataset using len()
load_index_maps: load and concatenate index maps from all JSON files in the base directory
